method: Source provenance queues are deterministic review-priority lists generated from evidence capsules. Queue membership is not a claim about severity, frequency, or institutional quality.

queues.label: Dataset cell locator review
queues.description: Records from dataset-file imports where a reviewer should confirm workbook, row, or cell basis before reuse.

queues.label: Source URL review
queues.description: Records whose current source metadata needs a stronger public URL locator.

queues.label: Single-source review
queues.description: Records supported by one linked public source in the current metadata.

queues.label: Response-depth review
queues.description: Records whose response field is a bounded source note rather than a substantive direct institutional response.

queues.label: Explicit rationale review
queues.description: Records that still need explicit classification, community, or confidence rationales.
